title: The pause and resume CLIs work only through a running dashboard API, and send DASHBOARD_API_KEY to whatever DASHBOARD_URL says, including plain http to another host

evidence.note: DASHBOARD_URL is honoured verbatim; no scheme or host check
when the dashboard is unreachable the CLI exits 2; there is no other way in the scripts to set the persisted pause flag
forwards the whole first Set-Cookie header line (with its attributes) as the Cookie header

sibling_sites_checked: Both CLIs (pause.ts, resume.ts) and their callers in package.json (:16-17). The NEVER-logged invariant holds in both: the key is only in the request body and no log call references it (pause.ts:83-117, resume.ts:47-79). The dashboard side of pause (controls.ts) and its auth are the API slice (AUD-API-001, AUD-API-007).
severity_rationale: S3: an operator override that points at a remote http dashboard sends the key in clear text, and an emergency pause is impossible whenever the dashboard API is down while trading continues; both need an unusual setup or failure, and the dashboard pause banner and Stop controls are alternative paths only while the API is up.
recommendation: Phase 29: refuse a non-loopback DASHBOARD_URL unless it is https; add an offline pause that writes the persisted pause flag directly (with the database rails) for when the API is down; parse only the session cookie name and value from Set-Cookie.
